isolation: Use per-task stack and synthetic data only; do not send messages or contact real applicants

scenarios.title: Responsive layout and focus
scenarios.given: Catalog/detail with chat open and filters/adoption modal available
scenarios.when: Exercise 320, 768 and 1440 px widths, 200% zoom, keyboard navigation and Escape and reduced motion
scenarios.then: No horizontal overflow or hidden focus; modal traps only when appropriate; chat respects inert background; cards and controls remain readable

scenarios.title: Chat lifecycle and ownership
scenarios.given: Two browser sessions and an owned conversation with saved turns
scenarios.when: Send Unicode/IME input, navigate/collapse pending work, reload, access a foreign UUID and advance TTL
scenarios.then: One pair per turn; original context retained; reload restores saved history only; foreign access returns 404; completed-turn-only 24-hour retention; no automatic resend
scenarios.method: Redis integration and Playwright conversation charter

scenarios.title: SSE contract
scenarios.given: A valid turn and saved replay
scenarios.when: Split network chunks within UTF-8/lines, inspect every event and saturate stream capacity
scenarios.then: Contiguous identity/sequence and exact delta equality; no text before commit; replay started/completed only; four slots bounded; a fifth returns 503 without model call
scenarios.method: Real Servlet HTTP transport and parser tests

scenarios.title: Interrupted stream and reconciliation
scenarios.given: A stream has started, a second has deltas, a third has completed
scenarios.when: Disconnect at each boundary, corrupt sequence, drop commit acknowledgement and fail post-completion history sync
scenarios.then: Incomplete text has no links; authoritative recovery deduplicates; completed answer remains confirmed; no automatic JSON fallback/mock/reconnect; actual permits/writers exit safely
scenarios.method: Fault-injected transport tests and Playwright recovery charter

scenarios.title: New and clear conversation
scenarios.given: Owned saved history and an active turn in another tab
scenarios.when: Start new conversation; clear active then idle history; lose cookie and try the old UUID
scenarios.then: Quotas unchanged; active clear returns 409; idle clear removes only owned transcript; a new UUID used; cookie loss never transfers retained ownership
scenarios.method: Redis session tests and browser multi-tab charter

scenarios.title: Environment loss during integration
scenarios.given: A requested batch with declared components and isolated endpoints
scenarios.when: Stop a required database, API or browser dependency between precheck and completion; change content after a passing run
scenarios.then: The batch starts only after every prerequisite passes; the watcher detects loss and marks BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT; changed content invalidates evidence; original application data is untouched

implementation: Each browser-required ticket creates its own executable quality/e2e/<TASK-ID>/*.spec.ts suite for that ticket contribution; full scenarios are aggregated at release
